blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58 and Mega Lotto 6/45 draws on Friday, Sept. 25, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 41-29-43-16-54-27 for a jackpot of ₱330.18 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 winning combination was 37-33-38-14-45-32 for a jackpot of ₱75.23 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. Minor games Draw schedule Ultra Lotto 6/58 draws are held every Tuesday, Friday and Sunday, while Mega Lotto 6/45 draws take place every Monday, Wednesday and Friday....
